title: Datadog Application key (ddapp_-prefixed): must be flagged
summary: Synthetic Datadog Application key (ddapp_-prefixed) values built to the documented format appear in 5 inputs in CI configuration, container and orchestration configuration, environment files, shell exports, and structured files (JSON, YAML, TOML). Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Synthetic value matches the pinned lexical format contract. Provider issuance, payload/checksum validity and liveness are not claimed.
